Package shared.message

package shared.message
  • Class
    Description
    ConnectMessage
    Handshake message sent by the socket client right after the connection is established, before entering the command flow: it communicates the name the player wants to register with.
    ErrorMessage
    Server→client message notifying an application error (e.g.
    EventResolvedMessage
    Server → client notification emitted once per resolved event card during EndOfRoundPhase (and EndOfGamePhase for residual events).
    GameOverMessage
    Game-over notification carrying the winners and (optionally) the end-game scoring breakdown.
    GameStartingMessage
    Server→client message signalling the game start: the lobby is full and the client must switch from the lobby screen to the game screen.
    HeartbeatMessage
    Heartbeat message sent periodically by the server to the client to signal that the connection is still alive.
    LeaderboardMessage
    Server→client message with the persisted leaderboard and the player's placement at the end of the game.
    LobbyListMessage
    Server→client message with the list of available lobbies, in response to ListLobbiesCommand.
    LobbyStateMessage
    Server→client message with the updated state of the lobby the player belongs to (e.g.
    ServerMessage
    Root of the server→client message hierarchy.
    ServerMessageVisitor
    Visitor over ServerMessage, implemented by the client side to react to each kind of server message (state update, errors, game over, lobby list/state, game start, heartbeat, leaderboard, event outcome) without resorting to instanceof.
    StateMessage
    Server→client message carrying the full snapshot of the game state; it is the main message the client uses to update its view.
